verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-infrastructure platform with deposit accounts, so automated statements and 1099-INT tax documents are a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions monthly statements, tax forms, or document retrieval endpoints. The general claim of API access to account and transaction data is adjacent, not the documented capability itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, the paper obligations are automated — monthly statements generated per account, and tax documents (1099-INT) produced and retrievable through the API
